constructs.adjudicable: The visible context, full selected resource, declaration, and response are sufficient to make a reliable judgment.
constructs.declaration_matches_response: The declared use or ignore action is observable in the response. This is trace fidelity, not decision quality.
constructs.resource_decision_appropriate: Using or ignoring the supplied resource is justified by current relevance, nonredundancy, boundary, and temporal status.
constructs.functional_execution: When use is declared, the resource makes a discernible source-specific contribution rather than a topical or vague surface mention.
constructs.material_misuse: Resource use creates an unsupported personal claim, stale/conflicting current assertion, overgeneralized cause or pattern, explicit boundary violation, or excessive directiveness sufficient to block adoption.

dual_review_reconciliation.reason: Reviewer 1 exceeds the pre-frozen misuse maximum; reviewer 2 falls below the pre-frozen functional threshold. Averaging cannot turn either failed qualification into a pass.
stable_findings: A prior-session work-shift explanation was promoted to an unsupported current cause.
A profile already repeated in the current turn is not an adjudicable test of profile use.
Vague continuity wording does not establish functional resource use.
Generator concise_decision_reason can invent visible cues and is audit telemetry only, never training gold.
dual_review_reconciliation.threshold_disagreement: One event-memory response promoted an old external-dependency task to the current situation; reviewers agreed on the failure mode but differed on whether it crossed the material threshold.

repair_boundary.fresh_recheck: 10 response-, judge-, risk-, and external-outcome-blind development states
repair_boundary.scope_limit: The fresh set contains positive resource opportunities and therefore checks use execution and misuse; it does not independently qualify the ignore path.

fresh_recheck_gate.adjudicable: at least 8/10; non-adjudicable items are reported and excluded rather than forced
fresh_recheck_gate.functional_execution_on_declared_use: at least 80% of adjudicable declared-use items
fresh_recheck_gate.failure_action: Report Step2 generator limitation; do not modify PM learning labels or external tests.

independent_summary_sensitivity.use: threshold sensitivity only, not a second 10-row dataset

fresh_recheck_result.robust_conclusion: Both reviewers pass adjudicability, decision appropriateness, and the frozen misuse maximum; both fail functional execution. The Step2 failure is therefore robust to the observed annotation threshold difference.
stable_failure_modes: The resource is declared or mentioned but does not alter the operative suggestion or question.
A strategy is topically approximated but its defining mechanism is not executed.
Relevant session distinctions are omitted even when they directly answer the current request.
threshold_sensitive_items: Implicit use of a prior-session distinction without naming its decisive concept.
Whether an open collaborative question is distinguishable execution of an MP preference or merely ordinary response behavior.
Whether one unhedged reuse of an earlier external-dependency explanation crosses the material-misuse threshold.

scientific_separation.step1: PM predicts source-level opportunity before resource injection.
scientific_separation.retrieval: The fixed source-specific retriever selects a concrete candidate and may abstain.
scientific_separation.step2: The generator decides whether and how to realize the supplied candidate without upgrading old evidence into current fact.
scientific_separation.outcome: Frozen same-state quality, interaction-and-grounding risk, and cost comparisons evaluate the whole system; outcome judgments are not fed back into external-test training.
